entities.summary: David Hunt Linder (1899–1946) was an American mycologist known for his work on the Helicosporous fungi and his dedication to advancing mycological knowledge. He curated the Farlow Herbarium of Cryptogamic Botany at Harvard University and founded the highly respected journal Farlowia.
